clinics.name: Preecha Aesthetic Institute (PAI)
specialties: Gender-affirming surgery (penile skin inversion vaginoplasty, orchiectomy)
clinics.namedDoctors: Asst. Prof. Dr. Preecha Tiewtranon MD (site: chairman of the Society of Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeons of Thailand, member of the Society of Aesthetic Plastic Surgeons of Thailand; former chairman of the plastic surgery unit, Chulalongkorn), Asst. Prof. Dr. Sirachai Jindarak MD, Asst. Prof. Dr. Prayuth Chokrungvaranont MD, Asst. Prof. Dr. Apichai Angspatt MD, Dr. Sutin Khobunsongserm MD, Dr. Burin Wangjiraniran MD (shown as FRCS on one page and FRCST on another). The site says all surgeons are board-certified but names no board; Thai Board of Plastic Surgery is not stated by name. No anesthesiologist is named.
clinics.credentials: Clinic, not a hospital. Site says general-anesthesia operations are done at two affiliated accredited private hospitals in Bangkok; the hospital page captions photos as Phyathai 2 Hospital and Vimut Hospital but does not state which performs surgery. Clinic operating rooms are described as equipped for local anesthesia. No MoPH clinic licence number published. Site gives conflicting founding dates (established 1980 in header; PAI established 2002 in founder text; Chollada Clinic 1978). HA Thailand accreditation-status directory checked 30 October 2026: it covers hospitals, not clinics, and its keyword search is form-driven so PAI's partner hospitals could not be matched by automated reading. JCI directory redirected to jointcommission.org and returned 403 on 30 October 2026. checkmd.tmc.or.th returned 403 to automated reading on 30 October 2026, so surgeons were not verified there.
clinics.cautions: Site states 'The first successful gender surgery Thailand since 1975' and other pioneer claims that cannot be independently verified. English-language press search found no reported death, lawsuit or regulator action tied to PAI; Thai-language court records were not searched.
clinics.publishedPrices: Not published on its site. Marketplace range (indicative), Thaiger Deals listing seen October 2026: male-to-female SRS THB 312,000 to 451,200 ($8,667 to $12,533 at 36 THB = $1); female-to-male THB 161,000 ($4,472). Most other procedures listed as 'inquire with the clinic'.

booking.channels: Form at https://www.pai.co.th/appointment/ (name, email, subject, message, file upload); email consult@pai.co.th; phone +66 2 715 0111; fax +66 2 715 0113; LINE link lin.ee/6xVTTz8; Facebook, Instagram, YouTube. No WhatsApp listed. Hours not published.
booking.consult: Not published. The appointment form asks you to 'send them back to PAI' with an upload field but does not say what to attach. No consultation fee, deposit, response time, or SRS eligibility requirements (letters, age, hormone duration) are stated on the site.
booking.languages: Site in English and Simplified Chinese.

clinics.name: Kamol Cosmetic Hospital (Dr. Kamol Pansritum)
specialties: Gender-affirming surgery (vaginoplasty incl. peritoneal, phalloplasty, metoidioplasty)
clinics.namedDoctors: Dr. Kamol Pansritum MD, chief plastic surgeon; Dr. Vipaphan Watson MD; Dr. Navin Klongkitkarnkha MD; Dr. Wichai Surawongsin MD; Dr. Sanipreeya Yingtaweesithikul MD; Dr. Akaradech Attainsee MD; Dr. Janjira Paengnoi MD; Dr. Tharatip Likkasittipan MD (all listed as plastic surgeons). Site says 'board-certified surgeons' without naming a board; Dr. Kamol's own doctor page lists procedures only. A third-party directory records Thai Board of General Surgery diplomas (1992, 1997) and an MD from Khon Kaen University (1986); Thai Board of Plastic Surgery is not stated anywhere seen. No anesthesiologist is named.
clinics.credentials: Self-described purpose-built cosmetic and gender-affirming surgery hospital at 1223 Lat Phrao 94, with an 11-bed recovery room and several operating rooms described on the facilities page; no bed count, ICU, or hospital licence number published. Site states 'As a JCI-accredited facility'; JCI directory returned 403 on 30 October 2026, so the claim is 'JCI claimed on hospital site; directory not reachable'. Not matched on the HA Thailand accreditation-status directory first page on 30 October 2026 (keyword search could not be driven by automated reading). checkmd.tmc.or.th returned 403 on 30 October 2026. Founding year not stated; site says 'over 30 years of expertise'. Former address was inside Bangkok Hospital Laksi Square.
clinics.cautions: February 2016: the Department of Health Service Support inspected Kamol Cosmetic Hospital after a social-media figure who was found not to be a doctor brought a former singer there for a 'Face Off' procedure; Dr. Kamol told inspectors he was not involved in advertising the service and the department said it was still gathering evidence (kamol-press-nation). No later regulator action was found in English-language press.
clinics.publishedPrices: Not published on its site. Marketplace range (indicative), Thaiger Deals listing seen October 2026: female-to-male gender surgery THB 336,000 to 724,500 ($9,333 to $20,125 at 36 THB = $1); MyMediTravel lists FtM at $9,337. Figures conflict across aggregators.

booking.channels: Phone +66 2 559 0155; WhatsApp +66 81 558 6969; email customercare@kamolhospital.com; contact form with a 'WhatsApp / Skype / Line etc.' field. Hours not published.
booking.consult: Site offers 'Book a free consultation, no commitment'. Pre-arrival page: a psychological evaluation is required before SRS and 'A letter from psychiatrist must be presented after the evaluation' (number of letters not stated); lab panel of CBC, electrolytes, anti-HIV, hepatitis screen, chest X-ray and likely EKG. Minimum age, hormone duration, real-life experience, BMI, deposit and payment terms are not stated on the pages read. Third-party listings cite minimum age 20 (parental consent at 18 to 19) and one year HRT plus one year RLE for metoidioplasty, which the hospital site did not confirm.
booking.languages: Site in English, Thai, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Italian, French, Portuguese, Korean, Arabic, Russian; 'over 10 languages' of support claimed.

clinics.name: Suporn Clinic (Dr. Suporn Watanyusakul; Dr. Chayamote 'Bank' Chayangsu; Dr. 'Prae')
clinics.namedDoctors: Dr. Suporn Watanyusakul MD (Chiang Mai University medicine 1979-1985; general surgery Chonburi Hospital 1985-1990; plastic and reconstructive surgery Chulalongkorn 1990-1992, 'certified 1992'; site says certified by the Medical Council of Thailand, no board named). Dr. Chayamote Chayangsu MD ('Dr. Bank'): Diploma of the Thai Board of Plastic Surgery 2014, Diploma of the Thai Board of General Surgery 2011, Royal College of Surgeons of Thailand 2012, Society of Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeons of Thailand 2015, Society of Aesthetic Plastic Surgeons of Thailand 2016. The 2027 calendar also names 'Dr. Prae' (a third-party page identifies her as Navipa Dusitanond), whose profile was not on the doctors page read. No anesthesiologist is named; the protocols page says clearance requires 'consent of the anesthesiologist at Aikchol hospital' while the hospital page says operations are at Samitivej Chonburi Hospital.
clinics.credentials: Clinic at 938 Sukhumvit Road, Chonburi 20000; general-anesthesia surgery is done at a partner hospital. The hospital page names Samitivej Chonburi Hospital (SCH), about 5 km from the clinic, with inpatient, ICU and emergency departments and 'HA Hospital Accreditation' listed as a feature; the protocols page still refers to Aikchol Hospital, so the two pages conflict. HA Thailand accreditation-status directory checked 30 October 2026: Samitivej Chonburi was not on the first results page and the keyword search could not be driven by automated reading, so HA level and expiry are not confirmed here. No clinic licence number published. checkmd.tmc.or.th returned 403 on 30 October 2026. Technique presented to the Royal College of Surgeons of Thailand in 2002; clinic founding year not stated.
clinics.cautions: Structural caveats stated by the clinic: no SRS under age 18, written parental or guardian approval and a gender dysphoria diagnosis for patients under 20, patients must be under 55 on the surgery date, and 'Dr Suporn does not undertake elective surgery on HIV+ (positive) patients'. Patients must stay at least 24 and preferably 30 days in Thailand. Surgery dates are released in a once-a-year window (2027 dates released 11 September 2026) and the surgeon cannot be switched after confirmation. Forum posts from 2017 to 2019 said Dr. Suporn was semi-retired; the current calendar lists only Dr. Bank and Dr. Prae. No press-reported death, lawsuit or regulator action was found.
clinics.publishedPrices: Not published on its site; quotations are given per case in THB on request. Fees stated: notarization via the Thai Medical Council THB 2,500 ($69 at 36 THB = $1); full notarization with notary public THB 6,000 ($167). Forum posts (not clinic figures) have cited roughly $15,500 for SRS in earlier years.

booking.channels: Email admin@supornclinic.com (English only); phone +66 38 273360 (clinic generally does not take phone messages); fax +66 38 273370. No LINE or WhatsApp listed. Thailand time GMT+7.
booking.consult: Complete and return the client profile form before the clinic will consider an application; SRS patients must send and bring original signed diagnosis or referral documents from psychosexual professionals (MD or PhD); full medical check-up report from your own doctor. Clinic says it follows WPATH guidelines 'as far as is considered reasonable'. Stop injected hormones 4 weeks and oral hormones 1 week before travel; stop smoking and heavy drinking at least 1 month before. Final clearance depends on admission tests and the anesthesiologist's consent.
booking.deposit: Minimum 20% of the quoted price within 14 days of requesting a date; balance no later than 30 days before surgery; inter-bank transfer only (no cash, cheques or cards). Cancellation more than 90 days out: full refund; under 7 days: 100% forfeited. Surgery must be completed within 2 years of the first scheduled date.
booking.languages: English; Japanese-language site section. Notarized documents are issued in English only.

clinics.name: Dr. Chettawut Plastic Surgery Center at WIH International Hospital (Dr. Chettawut Tulayaphanich, now Dr. Chettasak Tulayapanich)
clinics.namedDoctors: Dr. Chettawut Tulayaphanich MD, who the site says now practises as Dr. Chettasak Tulayapanich, founder and CEO of WIH International Hospital. Site: 'Board Certified for Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery' (board not named), craniofacial and maxillofacial surgery, former head of plastic surgery at Nopparat Rajathanee Hospital; member of WPATH, Society of Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeons of Thailand, Society of Aesthetic Plastic Surgeons of Thailand, Royal College of Surgeons of Thailand. Site states he is the only surgeon operating from start to end. No anesthesiologist is named.
clinics.credentials: Surgery is in WIH International Hospital, 1798 Debaratna Road, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, which the surgeon founded; the hospital site publishes no licence number, bed count or accreditation (no HA or JCI claim). An older directory address placed the practice at Vibhavadi II Hospital. Not found on the HA Thailand accreditation-status directory first page on 30 October 2026 (keyword search not drivable by automated reading). checkmd.tmc.or.th returned 403 on 30 October 2026. Founding year not stated; practice claims results 'since 1995'.
clinics.cautions: The surgeon's name on the site differs between pages (Chettawut Tulayaphanich vs. Chettasak Tulayapanich); confirm the Medical Council registration under the current name. English-language press search for 'Chettawut' and 'WIH International Hospital' found no death, lawsuit or regulator action.
clinics.publishedPrices: Only one figure on its site, undated, seen October 2026: 'extra charge of 32,000 THB' ($889 at 36 THB = $1) for an additional groin skin graft when needed. SRS base price not published. Historical forum posts cited THB 333,000 for SRS in the 2010s.

booking.channels: Email info@wihhospital.com; phone +66 2 078 8919; WhatsApp +66 95 650 3892; LINE @WIHhospital; YouTube, TikTok, Instagram. Hours not published.
booking.consult: Email-based: send the health information form and photos (4 facial views for FFS, 3 views for breast or body, JPEG 350 to 700 KB). Dr. Chettawut selects the surgery date after you give a preferred month. Lab tests 4 to 6 weeks before surgery (CBC, anti-HIV, creatinine, PT/PTT, fasting glucose, chest X-ray; EKG from age 42; stress test over 60), results reviewed at least 3 weeks before surgery. WPATH letters, minimum age and hormone duration are not stated on the pages read. No consultation fee stated.
booking.deposit: 20% by international wire within 7 days of agreeing the date; balance by wire no later than 4 weeks before travel. Cancellation terms not published.

clinics.name: Pratunam Polyclinic (Dr. Thep Vechavisit)
clinics.namedDoctors: Dr. Thep Vechavisit (also spelled Thep Vejvisith). No board certification is claimed by a clinic site; no official clinic website was found in October 2026, only an archival patient-made page. A January 2006 note to the Society of Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeons of Thailand (plasticsurgery.or.th) stated he 'is NOT a national board certified plastic surgeon in Thailand'. He told the Sydney Morning Herald (27 August 2006) he is a registered Thai doctor who did a two-month cosmetic surgery course through New York University. No anesthesiologist named; a 2006 reader report said he performed sedation himself.
clinics.credentials: Clinic (polyclinic) at 425/4 Rajaprarop Road, opposite the Indra Regent Hotel; no hospital affiliation stated and a 2006 reader report said Thai hospitals did not grant him privileges. No MoPH licence number found. Not applicable to the HA hospital list (clinic). checkmd.tmc.or.th returned 403 on 30 October 2026, so his current Medical Council registration status could not be verified here. All facts come from an archival directory page last reviewed 21 June 2025 and 2005 to 2006 press; current operating status is unknown.
clinics.cautions: The Society of Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeons of Thailand stated in January 2006 that he is not a national board certified plastic surgeon (thep-tgmap). The Sydney Morning Herald (27 August 2006) and Associated Press (20 August 2006) reported he publicly discussed a prospective patient (John Mark Karr), raising confidentiality concerns (thep-tgmap). The archival directory advises readers to consider other surgeons and reports unverified reader complaints of complications. The brief's phrase 'Bangkok Plastic Surgery' for Dr. Thep did not match any site found; the bangkokplasticsurgery.com domain belongs to Dr. Pichet Rodchareon.
clinics.publishedPrices: Not published on any clinic site found. Historical 2006 reader-submitted price list (indicative only, not current): sex change $1,625; abdominoplasty $1,250; breast augmentation $1,125; rhinoplasty $300. Bangkok Recorder (September 2005) reported $1,600 with a six-day hospital stay.

booking.channels: Phone numbers from the archival page: +66 2 254 5333, +66 2 255 7767, +66 2 254 5888. Email not readable. No current website, WhatsApp or LINE found.

booking.channels: WhatsApp +66 92 720 6393 (listed as 24/7); phones +66 91 770 7039, +66 86 398 4177; Thai hotline 1106; online consultation form at https://www.asiacosmeticthailand.com/online-consultation/; email obfuscated on page. No LINE listed.
booking.consult: Online form; USD 100 consultation fee unless booking. Staff reconfirm by phone, email or SMS one day before surgery and cancel the booking if they cannot reach you.
booking.deposit: Minimum 30% of the charged amount, non-refundable, paid per body part. Rescheduling under 7 days 10%, under 1 day 30%. Cancellation more than 7 days before 30%, under 7 days 50%, under 1 day 100%. If pre-surgery tests find you unfit, 30% is charged.
booking.languages: English site, Thai site (asia-clinic.com), Turkish section.

clinics.name: Superior A.R.T. (Oogonia Co., Ltd.)
clinics.namedDoctors: Not named on the FAQ or plan-your-visit pages read; no board certifications listed.
clinics.credentials: Fertility clinic at 1126/2 Vanit Building II, lobby floor, New Petchburi Road, Makkasan, Ratchathewi 10400, operating since 2007; no accreditation claimed and no MoPH clinic licence number published on the pages read. Not applicable to the HA hospital list (clinic). checkmd.tmc.or.th returned 403 on 30 October 2026. Legal rules as stated by the clinic: IVF 'can be provided only to a married heterosexual couple' (de facto couples only where local law permits); a certified copy of proof of marriage in English is required to start IVF or IUI; the clinic does not offer surrogacy and says it is permitted in Thailand only under very strict conditions. clinics.name: The Regeneration Center (stem cell clinic)
clinics.district: Bangkok (Watthana, 725 Sukhumvit Road, S-Metro / Metropolis Tower)
specialties: Mesenchymal stem cell infusions marketed for autoimmune, neurological, orthopedic, cardiac, lung, kidney and liver conditions
clinics.namedDoctors: Not named on the international page; site refers only to an 'internationally trained medical team'. No anesthesiologist applicable.
clinics.credentials: Established 2007 per site. Site states 'All four medical facilities are GMP-approved and fully licensed (including cell banking)' and that its team is 'fully licensed to perform regenerative medicine in the Kingdom of Thailand', linking to the Thai FDA site but publishing no licence number, approval reference or facility licence. Not applicable to the HA hospital list (clinic). checkmd.tmc.or.th returned 403 on 30 October 2026. Regulatory context: under Ministry of Public Health standards reported by The Nation on 31 October 2024, stem cell treatment in Thai medical facilities is permitted only for Medical Council-specified uses, mainly hematopoietic stem cell transplants for blood disorders (leukaemia, lymphoma, aplastic anaemia, multiple myeloma, thalassemia, congenital immunodeficiency); 'any stem cell injections beyond the treatments specified by the Medical Council' are illegal, and over 400 cases a year are prosecuted over exaggerated clinic stem cell claims. None of these treatments are approved by the US FDA.
clinics.cautions: The conditions this clinic markets (stroke, ALS, Parkinson's, COPD, lupus, Type 1 diabetes, 'reversing' GI disease, cancer immunotherapy) fall outside the blood-disorder indications Thai regulators say are permitted, and the site cites no Thai FDA or Medical Council approval for them (stemcell-nation). Discover Magazine reported a patient death in Thailand after stem cells were injected into the kidneys, and the Nation article cites the related pathology study (stemcell-nation). These therapies are not FDA-approved; consult your physician.
clinics.publishedPrices: Not published on its site; the site says recommendations are individualized rather than preset packages. Marketplace range (indicative), Bookimed 2025: stem cell rejuvenation in Bangkok average $7,813, range $1,800 to $25,000.

booking.consult: Online evaluation request with medical records; fees, deposit and response time not published.
